name: state
meaning: InstantMartianState 0..0xe; SetState 0x45862b stores its argument here, Update 0x456179 switches on it

name: behaviour
meaning: from PROPERTY_INSTANTMARTIAN_MARTIENBEHAVIOR: designer 1 -> 1, 4 -> 3, anything else 0 (0x455cca/0x455cd3)

name: stateTimer
meaning: ms left in the current state: 0x400 at load (0x455f7d), 0x800 or 0 entering state 2 (0x457d90/0x457d9f), 0x78 entering state 10 (0x458397); Update counts it down with g_dtMs (0x4575ce, 0x457793)

name: turnTimer
meaning: ms left before the martian may turn again while walking (0x457266 -= g_dtMs, 0 clears `turning`; reset to 0xfa at 0x457553)

name: sitAnimMs
meaning: duration of animation 0xf in ms (Anim_GetDurationMs at 0x455cec); the per-frame fraction of the sit move

name: heading
meaning: walk heading, 12-bit (0x457dc7 = rot.y + 0x800 & 0xfff)

name: turning
meaning: non-zero while the new walking heading is held: set to 0x800 at 0x45745f, cleared at 0x45728d when turnTimer runs out

name: holdingWolf
meaning: nonzero while Ralph is attached to the martian's joint 0x17; the setter 0x4579ad sends the Wolf message 4 / 5

name: shrunk
meaning: set by message 0x56; every size and speed the class uses is then divided by 3 (0x45869a), and the solid box swaps from 8 to 0x10

name: colForTraj
meaning: PROPERTY_INSTANTMARTIAN_COLFORTRAJ (0x455d65); nonzero = collide while following the trajectory (0x456e67)

name: nextPos
meaning: the position the walk step would reach (pos + step), tested against the run boxes before it is taken (0x456c2d, 0x457364)

name: homePos
meaning: placed position after SnapToGround, restored by Reset through SetPosition (0x455e47, 0x45601d)

name: target
meaning: the point to walk to: message 0x50 copies the sender's position here (0x457a96)

name: step
meaning: per-frame movement for the sit move: (target - pos) scaled by g_dt/sitAnimMs (0x45633a..0x4564a3)

name: toTarget
meaning: target - pos at the moment state 3 starts (0x457e36)

name: wolfPos
meaning: Ralph's position, 4 units above him, taken when the martian sits on him (0x4581f4) and used as its own position (0x4582f6)

name: lasers
meaning: every Laser (class 0x96) of the level, up to 55, from Scenaric_FindByClass (0x455e22)

name: laserCount
meaning: how many of lasers[] are filled

name: voice
meaning: Sound_Play handle for the running sound 0xdf (0x457ca1); SetState stops it first (0x457b97)

name: boxes
meaning: PROPERTY_INSTANTMARTIAN_BOX..BOX5, the boxes it may run inside; null properties are skipped (0x455dd9)

name: checkpointBox
meaning: PROPERTY_INSTANTMARTIAN_CHECKPOINTBOX (0x455e0b)

name: traj
meaning: PROPERTY_INSTANTMARTIAN_TRAJECTORY (0x455d0e)

name: patrol
meaning: the TRAJECTORY patrol (TrajPatrol_Init 0x459789 at 0x455d44, speed 600, radius 0x32; TrajPatrol_Step 0x4597f5 at 0x456e18). One 0x28-byte TrajPatrol: forward (+0x20 = 0x1dc) and forceAdvance (+0x24 = 0x1e0) are written through an inline whose this is &patrol (0x456e9a mov [ebp-0x9c],ecx; [edx+0x24]=1; [+0x20]^=1)

name: boxCount
meaning: how many of boxes[] are filled (0x455df3)

name: boxIndex
meaning: index into boxes[] of the box the martian is currently running inside (0x456210)
